newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rabo Securities cuts Heineken to a Sell.
newsitem.headline: Rabo Securities cuts Heineken to a Sell.

text.p: Rabo Securities said on Friday it had downgraded Dutch brewer Heineken to a "sell" from a "buy" on disappointing first-half 1997 sales volumes.

The broker said it expected Heineken to achieve earnings growth of only five percent in the first half of 1997 due to lower volumes in three of its major markets -- the Netherlands, France and Greece.
Sales in the U.S. are expected to be five percent higher.
The company would not have derived much benefit from the firm dollar as its exposure has been largely hedged, Rabo said.
Rabo Securities added it expected Heineken to underperform the stock market in the next few months but it should show an improvement in the second half of the year.
